parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside under the test path 'Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/' — specifically 'AudioPlayerControllerTests.swift' (MockAudioPlayerForController) and 'ObservationIntegrationTests.swift' (ObservationTestMockPlayer). These are test-fixture mock types whose structural similarity is a natural consequence of both standing in for the same production audio-player interface in different test scenarios. Consolidating them would couple unrelated test suites and risk obscuring test-specific setup differences. The restraint rule mandates no-action whenever any participating record is a test fixture, and both records here are unambiguously test-only.
